Welcome to Chitra Physiotherapy — 200,000+ subscribers strong and honoured with YouTube's Silver Play Button! 🏆

I'm Dr. Vinod Raj, a physiotherapist with 28+ years of experience treating disc bulge, disc prolapse, and spine conditions WITHOUT surgery. Since 1998, over 10,000 patients from India and abroad have recovered at our clinic in Pathanamthitta, Kerala.

On this channel you'll find:
✅ Surgery-free solutions for disc & spine problems
✅ Exercises for back pain, neck pain & sciatica
✅ Real patient recovery stories
✅ Stroke rehab, sports injury & arthritis care tips

New videos regularly — subscribe and take your better step today!

📍 Chitra Physiotherapy Clinic, Azhoor, Near Power House, Pathanamthitta, Kerala
📞 +91 98472 64214 | WhatsApp: wa.me/+919847264214
📧 dr.vinodraj@gmail.com
🌐 https://chitraphysiotherapy.com
